answer: In this PoA design, each verified identity must continuously complete a Wesolowski VDF: T dependent modular squarings followed by a compact proof. Because each squaring depends on the preceding result, an attacker simulating multiple clones cannot parallelize any chain across GPUs; every clone requires its own full sequential chain, imposing a strict physical time bottleneck. A seeded cipher, relic, and tundra checkpoint make challenges unpredictable and prevent replay.
